commentary.text: 90+9' Javier Alberola Rojas is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) misses the penalty as he smashes the ball against the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
90+7' It’s a PENALTY to Granada CF after the VAR review!

90+4' Play continues despite the shouts by some Granada CF players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Javier Alberola Rojas interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+3' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Granada CF for a penalty. Play continues.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Granada CF comes to nothing.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) comes onto the pitch for Facundo Pellistri.
89' Here is a change. Bruno Mendez is going off and Jose Ramon Sandoval gives the last tactical orders to Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF).

88' Vicente Guaita pulls off a great save to deny Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
86' 1 - 2 GOAL! Keeper Vicente Guaita totally miss kicks his clearance straight to Bruno Mendez (Granada CF), who rifles the ball back into the net from close range. It’s now 1:2.
85' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) replaces Carl Starfelt.
79' Claudio Giraldez is forced to make a change. Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) is unable to continue due to injury, Unai Nunez comes on.
78' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Granada CF.
77' The attendance is 11473.
73' Jose Ramon Sandoval decides to make a substitution. Raul Torrente will be replaced by Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF).
73' A substitution has been made. Martin Hongla is replaced by Oscar Melendo (Granada CF).

72' Raul Torrente (Granada CF) picks up a caution. Raul Torrente (Granada CF) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick.
68' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola Rojas didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Jorgen Strand Larsen and he is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).

63' 0 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Jorgen Strand Larsen, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo), who beats Marc Martinez with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 0:2.
61' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Hugo Sotelo laid the ball off to Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) will replace Sergio Rodelas.

51' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.

50' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
49' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) jumps into a tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas signals a foul. Celta Vigo earn a free kick.
46' The game is over for Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo). Jonathan Bamba comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Claudio Giraldez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo). He is replaced by Fran Beltran.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
45+1' Good work from Celta Vigo as they win a corner.
45' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45' A pass travels right across the box to Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom left corner, but Marc Martinez denies him with a decent save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Celta Vigo are going to take it.
44' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
44' It will be a corner kick for Granada CF.

41' What a miss! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
33' Raul Torrente (Granada CF) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
32' Granada CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
31' Granada CF fail to score from a corner as Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo) leaps to collect the ball.
30' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) tackles a bit over-zealously and Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul. Granada CF get a free kick.
28' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
27' The game is interrupted now, Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
24' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Celta Vigo are awarded the free kick.
19' A corner kick by Granada CF is thwarted by the well prepared Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo).
18' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Granada CF.
16' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
15' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
14' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Alberola Rojas saw the whole situation. Celta Vigo win a free kick.

13' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
8' Granada CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Granada CF quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
6' Granada CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
6' Celta Vigo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
2' Granada CF are ruled offside.
1' The match has just started.
Celta Vigo will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Javier Alberola Rojas.
